title: Lost or stolen U.S. passport
facts: A lost or stolen valid U.S. passport should be reported to the State Department as soon as possible to help protect against misuse.
Once a passport is reported lost or stolen, it is invalidated and cannot be used for international travel even if later found.
Reporting a passport lost or stolen does not automatically replace it; a separate passport application is required for a replacement.
Procedures differ depending on whether the person is inside or outside the United States.
